<robot name="sliding_cabinet">

      <mass value="30.0"/>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.66" rpy="0 0 0"/>

               iyy="8.6773" iyz="0.0"
               izz="12.2770"/>

  </link>

  <!-- Left sliding door -->
  <link name="door_left">

    <inertial>
      <mass value="5.0"/>
      <origin xyz="-0.445 0 0.66" rpy="0 0 0"/>

               iyy="0.3300" iyz="0.0"

  </link>

  <!-- Right sliding door -->
  <link name="door_right">
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.445 0 0.66" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.89 0.02 1.32"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="white">
        <color rgba="1 1 1 1"/>
      </material>

  <joint name="joint_left_door" type="prismatic">

    <origin xyz="-0.445 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>

    <axis xyz="1 0 0"/>
    <limit lower="0.0" upper="0.89" effort="100" velocity="0.5"/>
    <dynamics damping="0.1" friction="0.2"/>
  </joint>

</robot>
